tools.googleMeet: Great for video calls with your language partner. Works directly in the browser, no installation needed.
tools.googleAgenda: Use it to schedule conversation sessions, get automatic reminders, and never forget your meetups.
tools.deepl: Excellent for translating full sentences while keeping context and natural phrasing. Very useful while studying.
tools.reverso: Helps you understand how words and expressions are used in real situations through contextual examples.
tools.youglish: Lets you hear the correct pronunciation of words and expressions in real videos from native speakers.
tools.worldTimeBuddy: Makes it easy to find compatible times when you and your partner are in different countries and time zones.

proficiencyTestBanner.title: Want to know your level in a language?
proficiencyTestBanner.text: Take a free, quick test aligned with the international CEFR standard — the same one used for the A1 to C2 levels here on the platform. Available in several different languages.

helpPage.title: Help Center
helpPage.subtitle: Find quick answers, useful tools for your conversations, and channels to reach our team.

match.question: How do I find a compatible connection?
match.answer: The system uses the languages you speak, the languages you want to learn, and your interests to suggest people with the highest compatibility.

logSessions.question: Do I need to log every session?
logSessions.answer: It's not required, but we recommend logging your sessions to track your progress and practice history.

multipleLanguages.question: Can I practice more than one language?
multipleLanguages.answer: Yes. You can add multiple languages to your profile and find connections for each one.

editInfo.question: How do I change my information?
editInfo.answer: Go to My Profile and click the edit button to update your photo, description, languages, and interests.

report.question: How do I report inappropriate behavior?
report.answer: Contact our team through the support channels, letting us know what happened and any relevant details.

deleteSession.question: Can I delete a logged session?
deleteSession.answer: Yes. On the My Sessions page, just open the session details and use the delete option.

helpPage.moreHelpText: If you couldn't find your answer above, get in touch with our team.

escolaIdiomas.title: Shapers Language School
escolaIdiomas.description: Learn languages through real experiences and human connections, 100% free and collaborative.
escolaIdiomas.longDescription: A free, collaborative language exchange program: weekly conversation sessions, practical activities, and cross-cultural integration. Each participant teaches and learns at the same time.

reportIssueModal.title: We're here to listen
reportIssueModal.paragraph1: If something in a conversation or session made you uncomfortable — disrespect, inappropriate behavior, or anything that doesn't match what our community expects — we want to know.
reportIssueModal.paragraph2: Every report is handled with care and confidentiality. Our team reviews the situation calmly and, if needed, reaches out to better understand what happened. No report is too small — if something bothered you, it's worth telling us.

reportBanner.title: Need to talk to us?
reportBanner.text: If something in a conversation or session made you uncomfortable or outside what our community expects, let us know. Every report is handled with care and confidentiality.
